title: v3 claude upgrade is parsed but unwired, so nothing regenerates root CLAUDE.md in a v3-self-hosted project
body:
**CLOSED 2026-08-28: THE PREMISE IS EXPIRED ON BOTH HALVES, VERIFIED FIRST-HAND IN REPORT MODE.**

This issue was filed with an empty body, so the title is the whole claim: *"v3 claude upgrade is parsed but unwired, so nothing regenerates root CLAUDE.md in a v3-self-hosted project"*. Both halves are false today.

**"Parsed but unwired" -- false.** `intent claude upgrade` (no `--apply`, nothing forced) reports the set it would write on this v3-self-hosted tree:

    .claude/settings.json
    CLAUDE.md
    AGENTS.md
    usage-rules.md (only if absent)
    .intent_critic.yml (only if absent)
    .githooks/pre-commit.intent (the gate shim)
    .githooks/pre-commit (chain block, region-edited)

**"Nothing regenerates root CLAUDE.md" -- false, and confirmed by three independent reads rather than by the report alone**, because "reported unchanged" is ambiguous between *managed and matching* and *never looked at*, and that ambiguity is the thing worth ruling out:

1. Report mode NAMES `CLAUDE.md` in the managed set, above.
2. `canon.rs:395` is `for name in ["CLAUDE.md", "AGENTS.md"]` -- the two are handled in one loop, so whatever regenerates AGENTS.md regenerates CLAUDE.md.
3. `CLAUDE_MD_MARKER` (`canon.rs:100`) is `lib/templates/llm/_CLAUDE.md`, and this tree's `CLAUDE.md` footer carries that string. The marker is documented as **a consent check, not a version stamp**: a `CLAUDE.md` carrying it is regenerated normally, and only one WITHOUT it needs `--force`. So this tree's CLAUDE.md is inside the verb's ordinary reach, not behind a flag.

**ONE THING DELIBERATELY NOT CITED AS EVIDENCE.** The run was reported to me against commit `7fa3c013`. That commit is EMPTY -- single parent, no diff against it, and it appears in no `git log` for the paths its message names. The explanation is benign: `.githooks/pre-commit.intent` is git-ignored (`.gitignore:156`) because the shim points at a machine-local install root, so a path-scoped commit of it has nothing to record. The verb did run; the commit is simply not evidence that it did. The evidence above is first-hand and needs no sha.

Closed by intent-cc; expiry found by intent-dc and routed via intent-vc.
